name: 01.AI
short: Frontier lab behind the Yi series of bilingual MoE and coding models (Yi-Large, Yi-Large-Turbo, Yi-Large-FC, Yi-Vision), offered through a first-party API platform billed per token. API services temporarily unavailable from August 25th due to business adjustments; users directed to platform.lingyiwanwu.com.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free tier: $0 per 1M tokens, TPM 4, spending limit 32,000 tokens per the pricing table. API service temporarily unavailable from August 25th per platform notice.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Yi models billed per million tokens via the 01.AI platform: yi-large $3/$3 per 1M input/output, yi-large-turbo $0.19/$0.19 per 1M input/output, yi-large-fc $3/$3 per 1M input/output, yi-vision $3/$3 per 1M input/output. API service temporarily unavailable from August 25th per platform notice.
